# The OpenDoc edit vocabulary, version 1.1

29 commands in 6 families. 14 can be tracked suggestions, 12 are refused in suggest mode with the published reason, and 3 are not content edits (comments and review decisions). They are the agent-side twins of 52 editor command ids; 119 editor ids that can change a document are not exposed to agents, each with a reason (`commands.json` `uiNotExposed`).

| `op` | Family | Summary | Trackable | Editor twins |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `insert_text` | text | Insert text at an anchor. | yes | `edit.pasteText`, `insert.symbol`, `insert.emoji` |
| `replace_text` | text | Replace the quoted text with new text. | yes | `edit.replace` |
| `delete_text` | text | Delete the quoted text. | yes | `edit.cut` |
| `insert_paragraphs` | paragraph | Insert new paragraphs after an anchor's paragraph. | yes | none (agent-only) |
| `apply_paragraph_style` | styles | Apply a paragraph style, by name or id. | yes | `paragraph.heading.1`, `paragraph.heading.2`, `paragraph.heading.3`, `paragraph.normal`, `style.` |
| `set_text_format` | text | Set bold, italic, underline, strike, size, colour, highlight or font on the quoted text. | yes | `format.bold`, `format.italic`, `format.underline`, `format.strike`, `format.color`, `format.highlight`, `format.family`, `format.family.`, `format.size`, `format.size.` |
| `clear_formatting` | text | Remove direct character formatting from the quoted text; the paragraph style stays. | no: Clearing formatting cannot be suggested yet: a suggested format change is recorded as the properties it sets, and clearing sets none. | `set_paragraph_spacing` | paragraph | Set the space before and/or after a paragraph, in twips. | yes | none (agent-only) |
| `set_indent` | paragraph | Set a paragraph's start, end or first-line indent, in twips (a negative first line hangs). | yes | `paragraph.indent.increase`, `paragraph.indent.decrease` |
